commit_message: Add Timeline Audio and VFX typed track model
pr_title: Implement ADR 0126 Timeline and Sequencer runtime
pr_body: Adds the ADR 0122/0125-backed Audio/VFX Timeline typed model, stable clip lookup, binding diagnostics, and compiled payload variants. Follow-up requests complete runtime compilation/application and authoring integration. The PR remains Draft until ADR 0126 Definition of Done and required validation complete.
